title: Room DAO, Transaction, and Migration Tests Check

questions.prompt: Which approach gives the strongest evidence for room dao, transaction, and migration tests?
options: Build DAO and transaction tests plus migration tests from every supported schema version, verifying constraints, invalidation, rollback, indices, and retained user data.
Testing only fresh database creation while shipping an untested upgrade path for existing users.
Run the largest possible test with live services
questions.answer: Build DAO and transaction tests plus migration tests from every supported schema version, verifying constraints, invalidation, rollback, indices, and retained user data.
questions.explanation: Strong evidence identifies a risk, uses sufficient fidelity, controls variables, and produces actionable failure information.

questions.prompt: A passing test proves every behaviour in the production environment is correct.
questions.explanation: Every test has a defined scope, fidelity, inputs, and blind spots; confidence comes from complementary risk-based evidence.

questions.prompt: What should a test failure report besides the assertion?
questions.answer: Reproducible inputs, expected and observed state, environment, timeline, and relevant artifacts.
questions.explanation: Diagnostic context turns a red check into an actionable engineering result.
